Cultural Victory Counterplay
To conquer hearts, we must break some hearts. Hamper others' Tourism if we cannot increase our own.

To win the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CULTURAL_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Cultural Victory[/TIP], you need to make sure nobody beats you to it. One strategy, of course, is to earn points faster. However, that’s not the only option. [nn]Since the Cultural Victory is scored in part by having [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WONDERS_TOOLTIP]Wonders[/TIP], [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NATURAL_WONDER_TOOLTIP]Natural Wonders[/TIP], [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_UNIQUE_BUILDING_TOOLTIP]Unique Buildings[/TIP], [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ARTIFACT_TOOLTIP]Artifacts[/TIP], and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_UNIQUE_IMPROVEMENT_TOOLTIP]Unique Improvements[/TIP] in your empire, another strategy is to ensure your opponents have fewer in theirs. The most direct way to do this is by capturing their high [icon:YIELD_CULTURE][b]Culture[/b] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] through War. They won’t be worth as much when you control them, but they won’t receive any score when they’re no longer in their empire. [nn]You don’t necessarily have to capture them yourself. If they’re at War with someone, you can Support their opponent or use the Military Aid [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ENDEAVOR_TOOLTIP]Endeavor[/TIP] if available to make their war more challenging. [nn][TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SANCTION_TOOLTIP]Sanctions[/TIP] can also slow down a leader’s ability to generate [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TOURISTS_TOOLTIP]Tourism[/TIP]. Hinder Public Morale reduces their [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] so they enter fewer [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CELEBRATIONS_TOOLTIP]Celebrations[/TIP]. Worker Disruption slows their [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION][b]Production[/b], giving you a chance to finish a Wonder before they can. [nn]Consider [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ESPIONAGE_TOOLTIP]Espionage[/TIP], too. Spread Rumors of Fake Artifacts will reduce the target’s yields on displayed Artifacts to 0, for example.
Something to Try…

If you’re unable to catch up with an opponent’s [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TOURISTS_TOOLTIP]Tourism[/TIP], War is always an option. Consult with your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ADVISOR_TOOLTIP]Military Advisor[/TIP] on tips for waging War.
Cultural Victory Countdown
We have enough Tourism to win – now to complete the countdown!

To secure the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CULTURAL_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Cultural Victory[/TIP], you first need to reach the target [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TOURISTS_TOOLTIP]Tourism[/TIP] score. When that happens, a five turn countdown begins. This gives you an opportunity to prove your dominance and your opponents an opportunity to challenge your victory. [nn]If at any point your score falls below the target, the countdown pauses. You can fall below the target score by losing points, such as an opponent capturing a [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP]. You can also fall below the target score if the second place player earns enough points to push the target higher. Your progress on the countdown remains, though, so if you regain dominance you continue from where you left off. [nn]Once the countdown completes, victory is secured and the game is complete! That is, unless you decide to go just One More Turn…
Keep in Mind…
Don’t let your guard down. Anything can happen in these final turns.
Explorers and Artifacts
Artifacts are the Great Works of the Modern Age, remnants of Ages past. We must find them with Explorers and display them in Museums.

With the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MODERN_AGE_TOOLTIP]Modern Age[/TIP], you can now collect and display [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ARTIFACT_TOOLTIP]Artifacts[/TIP]. Artifacts are Modern Age [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GREAT_WORKS_TOOLTIP]Great Works[/TIP] that are found by Explorers and displayed in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Buildings[/TIP] like Museums. When displayed, they provide [icon:YIELD_CULTURE][b]Culture[/b] to the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] as well as [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TOURISTS_TOOLTIP]Tourism[/TIP]. Artifacts are an excellent way to earn additional Tourism in the Modern Age. [nn]The primary way to earn an Artifact is to have an Explorer excavate it from a Dig Site. To reveal the Dig Sites on a [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CONTINENT_TOOLTIP]Continent[/TIP], the Explorer must first Research the Artifacts of a Continent on a Museum or other location. Once this is complete, all Dig Sites are revealed on the Continent, and the Explorer can then move to those locations to collect them. [nn]Each Continent has a limited number of Dig Sites, and once any Explorer from any leader collects an Artifact from there, the Dig Site is exhausted. As a result, it’s important to move quickly and efficiently if you wish to collect many Artifacts. [nn]Artifacts left undisplayed give no bonuses, so remember to display them in a Museum or other Building with a Great Work slot. [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_OVERBUILDABLE_TOOLTIP]Overbuilding[/TIP] and narrative events can also yield Artifacts, but Archeology is the most consistent way to fill your Museums.
Keep in Mind…

If you haven’t yet, study the Natural History [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CIVIC_TOOLTIP]Civic[/TIP]. This allows you to construct Museums and train Explorers. Once you have an Explorer, first have them Research [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ARTIFACT_TOOLTIP]Artifacts[/TIP] on a tile with a Vase icon to reveal Dig Sites on the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CONTINENT_TOOLTIP]Continent[/TIP]. Once revealed, use the Excavate Artifact action on a Dig Site to retrieve an Artifact. You can collect multiple Artifacts and reveal Dig Sites on each Continent. [nn]You must have a [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GREAT_WORKS_TOOLTIP]Great Work[/TIP] slot to display an Artifact.

Military Victory Counterplay
Our victory depends on others' failure. Let's see what we can do to weaken our opponents.

To win the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MILITARY_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Military Victory[/TIP], you need to make sure nobody beats you to it. If any other leader has more [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] than you, the most direct way to deal with them is to capture their Settlements through War. Ideologies
In the Modern Age, wars are fought over Ideologies. Those that oppose our own should be our main target.

With the start of the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MODERN_AGE_TOOLTIP]Modern Age[/TIP], leaders can now commit to one of three Ideologies: Democracy, Communism, or Fascism. [nn]To adopt an Ideology, you must first study Political Theory then spend one turn studying the associated [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CIVIC_TOOLTIP]Civic[/TIP]. Committing to an Ideology is permanent and grants several [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MILITARY_UNIT_TOOLTIP]Military Units[/TIP] in the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CAPITAL_TOOLTIP]Capital[/TIP] and two [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ATTRIBUTE_TOOLTIP]Attribute[/TIP] Points depending on the Ideology. It also unlocks the associated Ideology’s Civics Tree, providing further bonuses when studied. [nn]Ideologies also greatly impact your diplomatic relations. Leaders with shared Ideologies gain a large boost to their [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RELATIONSHIP_TOOLTIP]Relationship[/TIP] while those with opposed Ideologies have a large penalty. In addition, [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] captured through War with an Ideological opponent are worth more [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MILITARY_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Military Victory[/TIP] Points.
Keep in Mind…

Choosing the Ideology that’s best for you is an important decision. Each Ideology provides different bonuses that are suited toward different playstyles. In addition, it’s important to consider the diplomatic consequences of your selection. [nn]If you’re pursuing the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MILITARY_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Military Victory[/TIP], being Ideological opponents with someone you wish to conquer will help you earn more points.
Flight and Air Combat
Once we research Flight, we'll be able to protect our skies as well as our lands and waters.

With the advent of flight in the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MODERN_AGE_TOOLTIP]Modern Age[/TIP], it’s now possible to build planes to rule the skies. [nn]To begin, you first need to research Flight. Once researched, you can construct an Aerodrome in any [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP], which is a special [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTRICT_TOOLTIP]District[/TIP] that allows you to train [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_AIR_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Air Units[/TIP]. [nn]Each Aerodrome comes with an Aerodrome [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_COMMANDER_TOOLTIP]Commander[/TIP], which allows you to pack Air Units and earns [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PROMOTION_TOOLTIP]Promotions[/TIP]. Unlike other Commanders, Aerodrome Commanders are stationary. Squadron Commanders are similar to Aerodrome Commanders, except that they can move and establish temporary Air Base tiles. Aircraft Carriers are Naval Air Commanders that act as floating Air Bases for Air Units. [nn]There are three types of Air Units, each specializing in a type of combat: [nn]- Fighters excel at air-to-air combat and can be set to Intercept incoming Air Units. [n]- Ground Attackers specialize in attacking [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_LAND_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Land Units[/TIP] and can cause heavy damage to an invading force. [n]- Bombers have high Bombard Strength and are great for damaging Districts, pillaging [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_IMPROVEMENT_TOOLTIP]Improvements[/TIP], and even bypassing Fortifications to directly attack the Units within. [nn]Air Units can only be [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_STATIONED_TOOLTIP]Stationed[/TIP] on Air Commanders, but can use the Rebase action to move between them.
Keep in Mind…

It’s important to maintain air superiority while at war in the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MODERN_AGE_TOOLTIP]Modern Age[/TIP]. Failing to do so can cause your Units to suffer major losses as they attack or defend. Bringing along a Squadron [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_COMMANDER_TOOLTIP]Commander[/TIP] on a forward push or an Aircraft Carrier while at sea can make a major difference in the outcome of a war.
Modern Military Triumphs
Military Triumphs can bring us even closer to victory. Let's take a look.

[TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRIUMPH_TOOLTIP]Triumphs[/TIP] can award [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MILITARY_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Military Victory[/TIP] Points or grant boosts to make it easier to conquer and control a large empire. [nn]For example, Terror From Above will provide a large boost to the range of your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_AIR_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Air Units[/TIP] if you have an Air [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_COMMANDER_TOOLTIP]Commander[/TIP] with 6 [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PROMOTION_TOOLTIP]Promotions[/TIP]. Additionally, Moral Imperative will award 3 Dominion Points if you conquer 6 [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] from a leader with a different Ideology. [nn]Consider the various Triumphs available to see which can help you best in your pursuit of Victory.
Keep in Mind…

Each Victory type has its own set of [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRIUMPH_TOOLTIP]Triumphs[/TIP] that can accelerate victory. Keep an eye on your opponents, especially if they complete Triumphs, as they can use them to quickly get ahead in another Victory. Remember, only the first leader who wins any path is named the victor!
Scientific Victory in Modern
At last the Space Race can be won, but first, we have work to do. Let me show you.

With the start of the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MODERN_AGE_TOOLTIP]Modern Age[/TIP], the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SCIENTIFIC_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Scientific Victory[/TIP] is now possible. [nn]To win a Scientific Victory, you need to earn 100 Innovation while controlling an active Launch Pad. After a 10-turn Countdown, Victory is declared as you escape the atmosphere! [nn]You’ve been collecting Innovation in the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ANTIQUITY_AGE_TOOLTIP]Antiquity Age[/TIP] and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_EXPLORATION_AGE_TOOLTIP]Exploration Age[/TIP] primarily through [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PROJECTS_TOOLTIP]Projects[/TIP] and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MASTERY_TOOLTIP]Tech Masteries[/TIP]. That continues into the Modern Age. Look for [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TECH_TOOLTIP]Techs[/TIP] that unlock key Projects like Trans-Oceanic Flight and Crewed Space Flight Preparation. Some of these Projects are even repeatable, allowing you to earn additional Innovation. [nn]You also need to construct at least one Launch Pad. Launch Pads are special [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTRICT_TOOLTIP]Districts[/TIP] that must be constructed on [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_FLAT_TERRAIN_TOOLTIP]Flat Terrain[/TIP] and take up the entire tile. They are unlocked after researching Rocketry.
Keep this in mind…

Why build one Launch Pad if you can afford two? While only one Launch Pad is required, additional ones can provide redundancy in case an enemy damages one. The Victory Countdown only progresses while you have at least one fully active Launch Pad.
Scientific Victory Counterplay
Be wary of our scientific competitors. If they get ahead in the Space Race, we must find ways to hamper them.

To win the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SCIENTIFIC_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Scientific Victory[/TIP], you need to make sure nobody beats you to it. [nn]The best option, of course, is to ensure you’re earning as many Innovation as possible, as quickly as possible, and have an active Launch Pad. There are some things you can do, though, to slow down the progress of others. [nn]First, [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SANCTION_TOOLTIP]Sanctions[/TIP] can be a powerful tool. Hinder Research will reduce a leader’s [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE][b]Science[/b] yield by 10%, directly slowing down their ability to research new [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TECH_TOOLTIP]Tech[/TIP]. Worker Disruption slows their [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION][b]Production[/b] of [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WONDERS_TOOLTIP]Wonders[/TIP] and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PROJECTS_TOOLTIP]Projects[/TIP], making it harder for them to complete [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SCIENCE_PROJECT_TOOLTIP]Scientific Projects[/TIP] or secure a key Wonder. The [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ESPIONAGE_TOOLTIP]Espionage[/TIP] action Sabotage Space Program can also directly hinder their ability to complete Projects and construct the Launch Pad. The other leader won’t like it, so be prepared to make a quick enemy. [nn]Of course, War is always an option. You must have an active Launch Pad to win a Scientific Victory, so damaging or capturing an opponent’s Launch Pad will set them behind.
Something to Try…
If another leader is close to [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SCIENTIFIC_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Scientific Victory[/TIP], keep them from winning by pillaging their Launch Pad.
Scientific Victory Countdown
We have nearly won the Space Race. Now for the countdown to launch.

To secure the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SCIENTIFIC_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Scientific Victory[/TIP], you need to reach 100 Innovation while controlling an active Launch Pad. When that happens, a 10-turn countdown begins. If your opponents don’t disrupt your launch by damaging your Launch Pad, you’ll win the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SPACE_RACE_TOOLTIP]Space Race[/TIP]! [nn]If at any point you no longer control an active Launch Pad, the countdown pauses. You can lose an active Launch Pad if an enemy damages it or takes control of the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP]. Your progress on the countdown remains, though, so if you regain an active Launch Pad, you continue from where you left off. [nn]Once the countdown completes, victory is secured and the game is complete! That is, unless you decide to go just One More Turn…
Keep in Mind…
Keep your Launch Pads safe. If you lose control of them, you’ll stop making progress on the victory countdown.
Modern Scientific Triumphs
Triumphs can grant much-needed bonuses that can aid in our victory.

[TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRIUMPH_TOOLTIP]Triumphs[/TIP] in the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MODERN_AGE_TOOLTIP]Modern Age[/TIP] can be an excellent way to accelerate the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SCIENTIFIC_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Scientific Victory[/TIP]. [nn]For example, Beyond the Sword provides Innovation directly if you are the first to complete [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PROJECTS_TOOLTIP]Project[/TIP] Ivy. Miracle over the Mojave provides additional [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION][b]Production[/b] to your Aerodromes if you’re the first to Break the Sound Barrier, making it easier to finish other Projects and construct your Launch Pad. [nn]Consider the various Triumphs available to see which can help you best in your pursuit of Victory.
Keep in Mind…

Each Victory type has its own set of [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRIUMPH_TOOLTIP]Triumphs[/TIP] that can accelerate victory. Keep an eye on your opponents, especially if they complete Triumphs, as they can use them to quickly get ahead in another Victory. Remember, only the first leader who wins any path is named the victor!
Economic Victory in Modern
The Modern Age is all about efficiency. Let's find the most efficient way to earn GDP – and win.

The [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MODERN_AGE_TOOLTIP]Modern Age[/TIP] has begun! Once again, the ways of the old world give rise to a new one. Where once we sought treasures in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTANT_LANDS_TOOLTIP]Distant Lands[/TIP], now we produce them in Factories and ship them across the world on Railroads. [nn]This is the final [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_AGE_TOOLTIP]Age[/TIP], and as such those who wish to achieve Victory must do so now. The [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ECONOMIC_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Economic Victory[/TIP] is awarded to a leader when they achieve economic dominance against all other leaders. This is measured in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GDP_TOOLTIP]GDP[/TIP], which you’ve been accumulating throughout the previous Ages as you assigned [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Resources[/TIP], constructed [icon:YIELD_GOLD][b]Gold[/b] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Buildings[/TIP], and unloaded [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TREASURE_CONVOY_TOOLTIP]Treasure Convoys[/TIP]. [nn]Victory is well within grasp now for any leader on any path. It’s important to balance both your own pursuit of Victory as well as preventing the Victory of others. Pay attention to the scores across each Victory type and react accordingly. As the Modern Age continues, the threshold for Victory will get lower and lower until a Victor is declared.
Keep this in mind…

With new mechanics come new ways to earn [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GDP_TOOLTIP]GDP[/TIP]. Construct Factories so that you can assign [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_FACTORY_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Factory Resources[/TIP], the most valuable [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Resource[/TIP] type for GDP.
Economic Victory Conditions Lowered
Victory is easier now, so we can relax a bit. Just a bit.

The [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ECONOMIC_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Economic Victory[/TIP] is awarded to a leader when they achieve economic dominance against all other leaders. This is represented as a score you must reach above the second place player. [nn]At first, the amount of economic dominance you need is extremely high. Doing so very early awards the Transcendent Victory, and it’s very difficult to achieve. As the game continues, the threshold lowers as follows: [nn]- Transcendent Victory ([TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_EXPLORATION_AGE_TOOLTIP]Exploration Age[/TIP] greater than 50% progress): 6x points [nn]- Crushing Victory (Exploration Age greater than 80% progress): 4x points [nn]- Decisive Victory ([TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MODERN_AGE_TOOLTIP]Modern Age[/TIP] greater than 20% progress): 3x points [nn]- Momentous Victory (Modern Age greater than 40% progress): 2x points [nn]- Substantive Victory (Modern Age greater than 60% progress): 1.5x points [nn]- Narrow Victory (Modern Age greater than 80% progress): 1.25x points
Keep in Mind…
Victory thresholds have changed. Check the Victory screen to see how you stand against the other leaders.
Economic Victory Counterplay
Our opponents can be just as ambitious as we are, but there are ways to make sure they're less successful.

To win the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ECONOMIC_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Economic Victory[/TIP], you need to make sure nobody beats you to it. One strategy, of course, is to earn points faster. However, that’s not the only option. [nn]Since the Economic Victory is scored in part by using [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Resources[/TIP], another strategy is to ensure your opponents have less access to them. When you’re expanding your territory, prioritize securing land with Resources before your opponents can. This applies both to settling new [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TOWN_TOOLTIP]Towns[/TIP] and when expanding your borders. [nn][TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRADE_ROUTE_TOOLTIP]Trade Routes[/TIP] are another major source of Resources, and imported Resources are worth more [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GDP_TOOLTIP]GDP[/TIP]. The only way to prevent your opponent from sending you Trade Routes is to declare War. That may be an extreme option, but if you and a few allies join a Joint War against them, they’ll lose access to a major part of the world market. Pillaging Factories and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_FACTORY_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Factory Resources[/TIP] can slow down their GDP, as well. [nn][TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SANCTION_TOOLTIP]Sanctions[/TIP] can also slow down a leader’s ability to generate GDP. Hinder Finances will reduce their [icon:YIELD_GOLD][b]Gold[/b] output by 10%, and Hinder Agriculture can slow their growth so they can’t capture Resources as quickly. They won’t like it if you Sanction them, though, so be prepared to make a quick enemy.
Something to Try…

If you’re unable to catch up with an opponent’s [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GDP_TOOLTIP]GDP[/TIP], War is always an option. Consult with your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ADVISOR_TOOLTIP]Military Advisor[/TIP] on tips for waging War.
Economic Victory Countdown
We have to complete the countdown before we can seal the deal and claim victory.

To secure the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ECONOMIC_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Economic Victory[/TIP], you first need to reach the target [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GDP_TOOLTIP]GDP[/TIP] score. When that happens, a five turn countdown begins. This gives you an opportunity to prove your dominance and your opponents an opportunity to challenge your victory. [nn]If at any point your score falls below the target, the countdown pauses. You can fall below the target score if the second place player earns enough points to push the target higher. Your progress on the countdown remains, though, so if you regain dominance you continue from where you left off. [nn]Once the countdown completes, victory is secured and the game is complete! That is, unless you decide to go just One More Turn…
Keep in Mind…
Don’t let your guard down. Anything can happen in these final turns.
Rail Stations and Ports
To earn the most GDP possible, we'll need a vast network to connect our Settlements together.

With the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MODERN_AGE_TOOLTIP]Modern Age[/TIP], you can now construct Rail Stations and Ports. [nn]After researching Industrialization, you can construct Rail Stations in any [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP]. A Rail Station occupies an entire tile and upgrades the roads connecting that Settlement to every other directly [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CONNECTED_TOOLTIP]Connected Settlement[/TIP] with a Rail Station. [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Building[/TIP] multiple Rail Stations creates a Rail Network. [nn]Your Rail Network, as a result, is every Settlement that directly or indirectly connects to your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CAPITAL_TOOLTIP]Capital[/TIP] via Rail. This Rail Network can connect to Settlements overseas with Ports, provided the two Settlements are on different [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CONTINENT_TOOLTIP]Continents[/TIP], and each Settlement also has a Rail Station. [nn][TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_LAND_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Land Units[/TIP] can instantly travel between Settlements that are in the Rail Network and within 20 tiles. This can allow you to quickly send units to where they’re needed in a time of War.
Keep in Mind…

The Rail Network is very important for the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ECONOMIC_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Economic Victory[/TIP], since you can only construct Factories in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] in your Rail Network.
Factories
Factories create GDP out of Factory Resources. Start by building out your Rail Network, then build Factories in connected Settlements.

Factories are an important element to the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ECONOMIC_VICTORY_TOOLTIP]Economic Victory[/TIP]. [nn]After researching the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TECH_TOOLTIP]Tech[/TIP] [b]Mass Production[/b], you can construct Factories. Factories are a special [icon:YIELD_GOLD][b]Gold[/b] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Building[/TIP] that allows you to assign [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_FACTORY_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Factory Resources[/TIP] to the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP]. [nn]Factories can only be constructed in Settlements in your Rail Network. The Rail Network is formed by all Settlements directly or indirectly [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CONNECTED_TOOLTIP]Connected[/TIP] to your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CAPITAL_TOOLTIP]Capital[/TIP] via Rail Stations and Ports. [nn]Once constructed, you can assign Factory Resources to the Settlement. Factory Resources are special [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Resources[/TIP] that provide empire-wide benefits and a large amount of [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GDP_TOOLTIP]GDP[/TIP]. Only one type of Factory Resource can be assigned to a Settlement at a time. You can assign multiple copies of the same Factory Resource to a Settlement, so it pays to be efficient!
Something to Try…

Construct a Rail Station in your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CAPITAL_TOOLTIP]Capital[/TIP], then a Factory. Assign [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_FACTORY_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Factory Resources[/TIP] to your Capital to gain a large boost to [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GDP_TOOLTIP]GDP[/TIP].
Economic Triumphs
If you really want to win, you'd best go after Triumphs that will give you a boost.

With the start of the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MODERN_AGE_TOOLTIP]Modern Age[/TIP], there are more ways than ever to earn [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GDP_TOOLTIP]GDP[/TIP]. [nn]There are several [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRIUMPH_TOOLTIP]Triumphs[/TIP] that increase the GDP value of things. For example, Wealth of Nations provides +2 GDP to all [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CITY_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]City Resources[/TIP] if you start 8 [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRADE_ROUTE_TOOLTIP]Trade Routes[/TIP]. Similarly, Rail Baron provides +3 GDP to all [icon:YIELD_GOLD][b]Gold[/b] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Buildings[/TIP] if you have 12 Rail Stations. [nn]You can also directly earn GDP with the Triumph Workshop of the World if you assign a large number of Factory Resources to Cities or Towns. [nn]Earning these Triumphs can be an excellent way to get ahead and claim victory.
Keep in Mind…

Each Victory type has its own set of [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_TRIUMPH_TOOLTIP]Triumphs[/TIP] that can accelerate victory. Keep an eye on your opponents, especially if they complete Triumphs, as they can use them to quickly get ahead in another Victory. Remember, only the first leader who wins any path is named the victor!
